author.name: Dom Jones
author.role_zh: 人師教育協會 Advocacy Chair

lead_en: A full academic year of English lessons, one complete plan per week, written by Dom Jones for the classrooms she teaches in across Changhua County.
lead_zh: 整學年的英語課程，一週一份完整教案，由 Dom Jones 為她在彰化各校實際任教的課堂所編寫。
note_en: Run it from week one, or open a single week and take the part you need. Nothing here is compulsory — see how we think about that in the library.
note_zh: 可以從第一週照著上，也可以只打開某一週、取走你要的部分。這裡沒有任何一項是規定——我們對這件事的想法寫在教材庫首頁。
principle_note_en: Every week runs on the same routine, so the routine can be predictable and the learning can be creative.
principle_note_zh: 每一週都走同一套流程——流程可預期，學習才有餘裕發揮創意。
status_note_en: The full plan for each week is going live one week at a time. Every week's title is already listed, so you can see the shape of the year.
status_note_zh: 每週的完整教案逐週上線；46 週的標題已全部列出，先看得到整年的輪廓。

weeks.title: Welcome Back: How Big Is Your English?
weeks.language_target: Diagnostic speaking + listening; sentence confidence; personal word bank.
weeks.taiwan_connection: Opening-year intention: establish a joyful, challenging classroom culture. Use this first class as a light diagnostic—not a test. Celebrate what students already know.

blocks.label: Homework review
blocks.text: Opening diagnostic: quick vocabulary, speaking, and listening challenge. No grades—just a baseline.

blocks.label: Vocabulary
blocks.text: Teach 5–10 target words. Always include: meaning, Chinese equivalent when useful, example, synonym, antonym, and/or word family.

blocks.label: New learning
blocks.text: Diagnostic speaking + listening; sentence confidence; personal word bank.

blocks.label: Fun / application
blocks.text: English Speed Round: picture naming, Chinese→English lightning round, synonym/antonym duel, and a 60-second 'All About Me' challenge.

blocks.label: Challenge / exit ticket
blocks.text: Each student produces something before leaving: a sentence, answer, mini-story, explanation, role-play, or spoken response. Keep it quick and visible.

weeks.media: Optional: a short kid-friendly 'back to school' or classroom-tour clip; pause before key words and let students predict.
weeks.homework: Build a personal English Word Bank: 10 words you already know + 5 new words. Write one sentence for 3 of the new words.
weeks.cefr: A1: name/point/use simple sentences. A2: add reasons. B1: tell a short story. B2: compare experiences. C1/C2: use precise vocabulary and explain nuance.
weeks.next_week: Next Saturday: review this homework first, then move into Week 02.
